# Creative AI

1,000 copy-paste Lovable mega-prompts pairing ten creative disciplines with the
four ElevenLabs voice primitives: streaming text-to-speech, conversational
voice agents, realtime speech-to-text (scribe), and generative music + sound
effects. One API key (`ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`), one Lovable build per idea.

Built during the Creative AI & Quantum Hackathon — StreetKode Fam · Indian
Krump Festival 14.

## Live demos

- /showcase/pitch-reader — Pitch Reader. Six curated ideas, each spoken aloud
  via ElevenLabs TTS streaming. Built in one Lovable prompt as proof of the
  5-credit budget.
